access_notes.walker: Published 2016 and 2020 articles are CC BY. No supplementary-material elements or PDF embedded files in the checked versions. Springer Fig. 4 is published by the authors under the article license and shows individual results without participant labels or force-tissue crosswalk. 2020 methods explicitly link the 2016 and 2020 cohort.
access_notes.massey: CC BY published Frontiers article, Tables 1–2. The university repository points to the article PDF. No participant sheet admitted; associated strength paper Balshaw 2016 uses unequal analytic Ns, so no individual joins or pooling.
access_notes.zoger: Published tables and panels in final article. The authors' data statement requires a request for original data. Only Fig. 2 panels A and D and summary tables are used. Consult the license attached to the current publisher version before redistribution.
access_notes.petrovic: 2019 publisher PDF Table 1 with three angles and body mass summary. Graph is a regression of dynamic leg press against 140-degree force without individual geometric covariates or identifiers. License for raw redistribution not established.
access_notes.other: Walker 2017 endocrine subset does not add direct tendon outcome; the relevant tissue extension is Walker 2020. Werkhausen 2018/2019 compares training and nontraining control in plantarflexion, distinct from the active protocol and target leg press. HARDEN remains partial per EXP-0140. No closed files or new measurements requested.
